sources.snippet: Kurtis E1 Toolkit Kurtis is an experimental fine-tuning, evaluation and inference tool for Kurtis E1. Kurtis is aN assistant designed with empathy at its core. Unlike other AI models that aim for peak efficiency, Kurtis prioritizes understanding, emotional nuance, and meaningful conversations.
